comments.text: I came to US from Sarajevo in 1995, right after the war, and I remember anyone who ever asked me where I am from when I said Bosna and Hercegovina they frowned and said huh??  Few people knew and heard of Sarajevo from the bad news of war and stuff but, no one really knew anything more. Now any time I go back to Sarajevo, just before entering the city, whether by plane or bus or car I cry, and I can't identify if the my tears are tears of joy or sadness but, my heart knows that I have returned home and that's where I belong. I still live in US, with an American wife but sevdah is always in the heart. "Bez sevdaha ne zivi Bosanac ni kad svjetom luta kao stranac" translates "Bosnian don't live without sevdah even when they travel world as stranger" Thank you for this amazing documentary about my country.
